name: HavocAI
description: HavocAI is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: HavocAI, which now uses the name Havoc, is a privately held defense technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price, and the company has not disclosed a valuation for any of its funding rounds. Its most recent financing, a $100 million Series A round announced on May 12, 2026, brought its total capital raised since 2024 to $200 million.

Founded in 2024, HavocAI builds autonomous boats and the software that allows a single operator to direct many uncrewed vehicles at sea, in the air and on land. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: HavocAI has not disclosed a valuation for any round. It did not give a series label to the $85 million it announced in October 2025.
round_notes: The company did not name a lead investor for the Series A. With that announcement, it said it had built and deployed more than 100 autonomous surface vessels; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: New investors in the Series A included Cobalt Capital, Boardman Bay Capital Management, Clear Street and SAIC. B Capital, In-Q-Tel, Lockheed Martin and Hanwha invested in the October 2025 financing, and Scout Ventures led the 2024 seed round, with Trousdale Ventures as co-lead. Other investors include Outlander VC, UP.Partners and Taiwania Capital.
spv_sentence: Since 2025, four special purpose vehicles formed to invest in HavocAI have filed with the SEC, three of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: HavocAI's announcements of its Series A, its October 2025 financing and its seed round; a Fortune report dated October 9, 2025; and SEC Form D filings.
